title: FACT AI
summary: A reproducibility study of the DECAF fairness-aware synthetic tabular data generator, comparing it against CTGAN and FairGAN baselines on classification datasets. The repository vendors a CTGAN source tree and calls CTGANSynthesizer (both the standalone ctgan package and, in one notebook, sdv.single_table.CTGANSynthesizer) as a baseline generator to benchmark against DECAF.
evidence: "ctgan = CTGANSynthesizer(epochs=10)" (.ipynb:283); CTGAN/FACT_GAN.ipynb:46 imports `from sdv.single_table import CTGANSynthesizer`
needs: Unclear whether the vendored CTGAN/ directory is a plain fork of the standalone ctgan package or was itself modified to call sdv.single_table; the sdv.single_table call site itself isn't shown, only the import.
